biotools.summary: Cancer Hallmark Enrichment Analysis provides a gene set enrichment analysis for cancer hallmarks, integrating a consensus gene set (n=6763) from multiple projects. The online tool (www.cancerhallmarks.com) identifies cancer-associated hallmarks from new gene sets and provides enrichment plots.
